sentences.text: Laiyangosaurus was a duck-billed dinosaur belonging to the family Hadrosauridae, the subfamily Saurolophinae, and the tribe Edmontosaurini.
Only one species, Laiyangosaurus youngi, is known from this extinct genus.
Excavations in the Laiyang Basin have uncovered diverse fossils, including insects, plants, vertebrates, dinosaurs, and dinosaur eggs.
This animal lived during the Maastrichtian stage of the Cretaceous period, roughly 72 million years ago, with an estimated time range extending back to 83.6 million years ago.
Scientists debate whether some specimens assigned to Laiyangosaurus actually belong to kritosaurine or lambeosaurine hadrosaurids instead.
